title: ervilia pisiformis
intro: Ervilia pisiformis, commonly known as the 'Pisum', is a species of flowering plant in the pea family (Fabaceae). This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and acting as an antioxidant. The therapeutic actions of Ervilia pisiformis are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, lowering blood pressure and improving blood flow. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
